description: A One health probe reported a CRITICAL dependency DOWN (DB / Vertex / Deep Research). Non-critical scraper VMs are excluded on purpose: they degrade scrape depth but leave the product serving, and their real failure signal is one_scraper_session_blocked. The second OR clause reads the pre-`criticalDown` log shape so the metric keeps working across a rollback.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" resource.labels.service_name="one" jsonPayload.event="one.health.check" (jsonPayload.criticalDown>0 OR (jsonPayload.summary.down>0 AND (jsonPayload.notUp:"database" OR jsonPayload.notUp:"vertex" OR jsonPayload.notUp:"deep_research_api")))
